snippet.title: Directory Dungeon - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Directory Dungeon is a tiny dungeon crawler played right in the windows file explorer. Explore a monster and loot filled dungeon by dragging and dropping your player folder into new rooms, equip powerful files, defeat terrible monsters, and banish evil once and for all.

Available MARCH 2026!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333010
Itch: https://juhrjuhr.itch.io/directory-dungeon
Discord: https://discord.gg/cQCET4NrgG
